name: re-encrypt-skill
description: Identify how an app encrypts its HTTP traffic, obtain the key, and generate the Re:Encrypt or standalone decrypt/re-encrypt setup.

interface.shortDescription: Decrypt an app's encrypted HTTP traffic.
interface.longDescription: Analyzes APK/IPA artifacts and captured traffic to determine the encryption scheme and key source, proves it by decrypting a real sample, and emits a Re:Encrypt configuration plus a runbook. Includes stdlib-only triage, ciphertext analysis, an AES/RSA/JWE CLI worker, and frida hooks for runtime key capture.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the decrypt-app-traffic skill on the app artifacts in this directory.
